summary: Phase 9I Operations → Departure Management UI verified end-to-end. Super Admin sees 'Operations' menu, /operations renders (data-testid=operations-page). Upcoming filter buttons within-all/7/14/30/60 all present; default 'Semua' lists departures. Target departure 6a7a9abd743c2458fcee9eba visible with '1/20 seat · sisa 19' (TOUR TEST_P3_pkg 2026-06-01). Clicking it renders departure-detail with alerts-panel containing alert-PAYMENT_DUE + alert-DOCS_INCOMPLETE. Tab Dashboard shows Total Seat=20, Booked=1, Available=19, Paid=0, Partial=1, Unpaid=0, Docs Complete=0, Docs Missing=1 plus 'Dokumen wajib' list. Tab Passengers shows passenger-table with row for 'Test Jamaah 9F' (Male, A1234567, PARTIAL, INCOMPLETE, CONFIRMED). RBAC: Sales login → no 'Operations' item in sidebar; direct /operations navigation renders shell but API returns 403 → departures-empty state shown gracefully (no crash).

issues: Recharts warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1)' still appearing repeatedly on dashboard chart mount — non-blocking noise, unchanged since iteration 31

Empty state for Sales (403) shows generic 'Tidak ada keberangkatan pada rentang ini' — could be more informative ('Access denied') but acceptable since menu is hidden for Sales.
Recharts responsive container width/height warnings persist across dashboard – add minWidth/minHeight to ResponsiveContainer.
